actionArea.zh-CN: 自定义底部操作区域的 snippet，参数 `upload` 为上传节点（showUploadButton 为 false 时是隐藏的 Upload，仍需渲染才能粘贴上传）、`send` 为发送或停止按钮，均是 snippet，用 `{@render}` 渲染；`class` 为操作区域的类名。
actionArea.en-US: Snippet that replaces the footer action area. `upload` is the upload node (a hidden Upload when showUploadButton is false; it must still be rendered for pasted files to upload) and `send` is the send or stop button, both snippets rendered with `{@render}`; `class` is the class name of the action area.

canSend.zh-CN: 是否可以发送。未设置时，根据输入框内容和上传内容决定；引用内容不参与判断。
canSend.en-US: Whether sending is allowed. When unset, it depends on the input content and the uploaded files; references do not count.

clearContentOnGenerating.zh-CN: generating 从 false 变为 true 时，是否清空输入框内容和附件。设为 false 可保留输入内容（适用于无限画布等非对话场景）。
clearContentOnGenerating.en-US: Whether the input content and attachments are cleared when generating turns on. Set it to false to keep the input (for non-conversational scenes such as an infinite canvas).

configureArea.zh-CN: 底部配置区域的 snippet，放置 `AIChatInput.Configure` 的各配置项。
configureArea.en-US: Snippet for the footer configure area, holding the `AIChatInput.Configure` items.

defaultContent.zh-CN: 输入框默认内容，支持 html string 以及 json 格式，同 Tiptap 的 Content；只在创建编辑器时读取。
defaultContent.en-US: Default content of the input, an html string or JSON like Tiptap's Content. Read once, when the editor is created.

dropdownMatchTriggerWidth.zh-CN: 下拉弹出层是否与输入框宽度一致。
dropdownMatchTriggerWidth.en-US: Whether the dropdown layer has the same width as the input.

extensions.zh-CN: 自定义 tiptap 扩展；只在创建编辑器时读取，之后变化不生效。
extensions.en-US: Custom tiptap extensions. Read once, when the editor is created; later changes have no effect.

generating.zh-CN: 是否正在生成中。为 true 时发送按钮变为停止生成按钮。
generating.en-US: Whether a response is being generated. While true, the send button becomes the stop button.

keepSkillAfterSend.zh-CN: 发送消息后是否保留已选的技能。
keepSkillAfterSend.en-US: Whether the selected skill is kept after a message is sent.

onBlur.zh-CN: 富文本输入框失焦时的回调。会遮住根元素上的原生 onblur。
onBlur.en-US: Called when the rich text input loses focus. It shadows the native onblur on the root element.

onConfigureChange.zh-CN: 配置区域发生变化时的回调，参数为全部配置值和本次变化的值；移除配置项时第二个参数为 undefined。
onConfigureChange.en-US: Called when the configure area changes, with the whole value and the changed value; the second argument is undefined when an item is removed.

onContentChange.zh-CN: 输入框内容变化时的回调，参数为当前内容项列表。
onContentChange.en-US: Called when the input content changes, with the current content items.

onFocus.zh-CN: 富文本输入框聚焦时的回调。会遮住根元素上的原生 onfocus。
onFocus.en-US: Called when the rich text input gets focus. It shadows the native onfocus on the root element.

onMessageSend.zh-CN: 点击发送按钮时的回调，参数包含引用、上传文件、输入内容和配置区域内容。
onMessageSend.en-US: Called when the send button is clicked, with the references, attachments, input contents and configure values.

onPaste.zh-CN: 监听输入框的粘贴事件，不阻止默认粘贴行为，可通过 event.clipboardData 获取内容。会遮住根元素上的原生 onpaste。
onPaste.en-US: Listens to paste in the input without preventing the default behavior; read event.clipboardData for the content. It shadows the native onpaste on the root element.

onReferenceClick.en-US: Called when a reference is clicked.

onReferenceDelete.zh-CN: 删除引用时的回调。引用由使用方持有，需要在回调中自行移除。
onReferenceDelete.en-US: Called when a reference is deleted. The caller owns the references and removes the item itself.

onSkillChange.zh-CN: 技能切换时的回调，移除技能时参数为 undefined。
onSkillChange.en-US: Called when the skill changes; the argument is undefined when the skill is removed.

onStopGenerate.zh-CN: 点击停止生成按钮时的回调。
onStopGenerate.en-US: Called when the stop button is clicked.

onUploadChange.zh-CN: 上传文件列表变化时的回调。
onUploadChange.en-US: Called when the uploaded file list changes.

placeholder.zh-CN: 输入框占位符，可以是字符串，也可以是按节点返回字符串的函数。
placeholder.en-US: Placeholder of the input: a string, or a function that returns a string for a node.

popoverProps.zh-CN: 下拉弹出层的配置参数；class 与内部类名合并，style 字符串与面板宽度合并。
popoverProps.en-US: Props of the dropdown layer. The class is merged with the internal class names and the style string with the panel width.

reference.zh-CN: 自定义渲染每个引用的 snippet，参数为 `item` 与 `index`。
reference.en-US: Snippet that replaces each reference, with the parameters `item` and `index`.

round.zh-CN: 底部的配置区域和操作区域按钮是否为全圆角。
round.en-US: Whether the buttons of the footer configure and action areas are fully rounded.

sendHotKey.zh-CN: 发送输入内容的键盘快捷键。enter 表示单独按下 Enter 发送，Shift 与 Enter 同时按下仅换行；shift+enter 相反。
sendHotKey.en-US: Keyboard shortcut that sends the input. enter sends on Enter alone and breaks the line on Shift+Enter; shift+enter is the reverse.

showPlaceholderWhenSkillOnly.zh-CN: 仅选中技能（无其他内容）时是否显示占位符，开启后占位符显示在技能后方；只在创建编辑器时读取。
showPlaceholderWhenSkillOnly.en-US: Whether the placeholder shows when only a skill is selected, after the skill. Read once, when the editor is created.

showReference.zh-CN: 是否展示引用区域，用于配合 `topSlot` 使用。
showReference.en-US: Whether the reference area is shown; use it together with `topSlot`.

showTemplateButton.zh-CN: 是否展示模板按钮。未设置时，根据当前选中技能的 hasTemplate 决定。
showTemplateButton.en-US: Whether the template button is shown. When unset, it follows hasTemplate of the selected skill.

showUploadButton.zh-CN: 是否显示右侧上传按钮。设为 false 时粘贴上传仍然有效。
showUploadButton.en-US: Whether the upload button on the right is shown. Paste upload still works when false.

showUploadFile.zh-CN: 是否展示上传文件区域，用于配合 `topSlot` 使用。
showUploadFile.en-US: Whether the uploaded files area is shown; use it together with `topSlot`.

skillHotKey.zh-CN: 输入框中触发技能面板的热键。
skillHotKey.en-US: Hotkey that opens the skill panel in the input.

skillIcon.zh-CN: 技能面板中每个技能前的图标 snippet，参数为 `item` 与 `index`。
skillIcon.en-US: Snippet for the icon before each skill in the skill panel, with the parameters `item` and `index`.

skillItem.zh-CN: 自定义技能列表每一项的 snippet，参数含 `skill` 和需要展开到根元素上的 `id`、`class`、`role`、`aria-selected`、`onclick`、`onmouseenter`。
skillItem.en-US: Snippet that replaces each skill. Parameters: `skill`, and `id`, `class`, `role`, `aria-selected`, `onclick` and `onmouseenter` to spread onto the root element.

skills.zh-CN: 技能列表。技能只含数据，图标使用 `skillIcon` snippet。
skills.en-US: Skills. A skill holds data only; its icon goes through the `skillIcon` snippet.

suggestionItem.zh-CN: 自定义每个建议项的 snippet，参数含 `suggestion` 和需要展开到根元素上的 `id`、`class`、`role`、`aria-selected`、`onclick`、`onmouseenter`。
suggestionItem.en-US: Snippet that replaces each suggestion. Parameters: `suggestion`, and `id`, `class`, `role`, `aria-selected`, `onclick` and `onmouseenter` to spread onto the root element.

suggestions.zh-CN: 建议列表，每项为字符串或带 content 的对象。
suggestions.en-US: Suggestions, each a string or an object with content.

template.zh-CN: 模板面板内容的 snippet，参数为当前技能 `skill` 与用传入内容替换输入框内容的 `onTemplateClick`。
template.en-US: Snippet for the content of the template panel, with the current `skill` and `onTemplateClick`, which replaces the input content with the given content.

templatesCls.en-US: Class name of the template panel.

templatesStyle.zh-CN: 模板面板的样式字符串。
templatesStyle.en-US: Style string of the template panel.

topSlot.zh-CN: 自定义顶部区域的 snippet，参数含引用、上传内容、输入内容和删除方法（`references`、`attachments`、`content`、`onUploadFileDelete`、`onReferenceDelete`）。位置由 topSlotPosition 决定。
topSlot.en-US: Snippet for a custom top area, with the references, attachments, content and delete methods (`references`, `attachments`, `content`, `onUploadFileDelete`, `onReferenceDelete`) as parameters. Placed by topSlotPosition.

topSlotPosition.zh-CN: `topSlot` 的位置，相对于引用区域与上传文件区域。
topSlotPosition.en-US: Position of `topSlot` relative to the reference area and the uploaded files area.

transformer.zh-CN: 自定义扩展的转换规则，键为节点名，值为把节点转换成 onContentChange 内容项的函数。
transformer.en-US: Transform rules of custom extensions: the key is the node name, the value turns the node into an onContentChange item.

uploadButton.zh-CN: 自定义上传按钮内容的 snippet，上传与粘贴上传逻辑仍由组件托管；参数含 `defaultNode`（snippet）、`onOpenFileDialog`、`disabled`、`attachments`。
uploadButton.en-US: Snippet that replaces the upload button content while Upload keeps handling uploads and pasted files. Parameters: `defaultNode` (a snippet), `onOpenFileDialog`, `disabled`, `attachments`.

uploadProps.zh-CN: 上传文件相关配置，同 Upload，但不接受 fileList、listType 与 children；初始附件用 `defaultFileList`；onChange、onRemove 由 AIChatInput 自己调用，beforeRemove 支持 Promise。
uploadProps.en-US: Upload settings, as Upload but without fileList, listType and children; seed the attachments with `defaultFileList`. AIChatInput calls onChange and onRemove itself; beforeRemove may return a Promise.

uploadTip.zh-CN: 上传按钮提示内容的 snippet。
uploadTip.en-US: Snippet for the content of the upload tip.

uploadTipProps.zh-CN: 上传按钮提示的 Tooltip 配置，不含 content；提示内容使用 `uploadTip` snippet。
uploadTipProps.en-US: Tooltip props of the upload tip without content; the tip content goes through the `uploadTip` snippet.

changeTemplateVisible.zh-CN: 切换模板弹出层的可见性。
changeTemplateVisible.en-US: Shows or hides the template layer.

deleteContent.zh-CN: 删除富文本中的某一项，按 content 中的 uniqueKey 匹配。
deleteContent.en-US: Deletes an item of the rich text, matched by uniqueKey of the content.

deleteUploadFile.zh-CN: 删除上传文件中的某一项。

focusEditor.zh-CN: 聚焦输入框，默认聚焦到末尾。
focusEditor.en-US: Focuses the input, at the end by default.

getEditor.zh-CN: 获取 tiptap 的 editor 实例，编辑器创建前为 undefined。
getEditor.en-US: Returns the tiptap editor, or undefined until the editor is created.

setContentWhileSaveTool.zh-CN: 保留技能项的同时设置输入框内容。
setContentWhileSaveTool.en-US: Sets the input content and keeps the skill.
